svg.title: Product Line Revenue Share — stepped pseudo-3D donut
svg.desc: Orthographic elliptical projection. All sectors share a base; heights are decorative. External labels encode category and rounded revenue share.
svg.metadata: {"categories": ["Enterprise Services", "Consumer Electronics", "Cloud Computing", "IoT", "Others"], "series": [{"name": "Revenue", "values": [182, 146, 104, 62, 26]}], "colors": ["#3B82F6", "#10B981", "#F59E0B", "#8B5CF6", "#CBD5E1"], "encoding": "Pre-projection sector angles = value / total * 360; displayed shares rounded.", "projection": {"kind": "orthographic", "center": [640, 475], "outer_radius": 260, "inner_radius": 145, "y_scale": 0.55}, "styling": {"common_base_z": 0, "sector_heights": [130, 56, 86, 150, 178], "height_encodes_data": false, "curve_sampling_degrees": 0.75, "max_chord_error_px": 0.00557}, "default_palette": {"id": "lavender-spring", "name": "科研配色｜薰紫春庭", "colors": ["#8F86B4", "#B7ACCD", "#DBCCE2", "#D6A3B1", "#E8CCAB", "#A8C3B5"], "roles": {"primary": "#8F86B4", "secondary": "#B7ACCD", "surface_accent": "#DBCCE2", "emphasis": "#D6A3B1", "warm": "#E8CCAB", "positive": "#A8C3B5", "negative": "#D6A3B1", "neutral_data": "#B7ACCD", "text": "#241F30", "secondary_text": "#655E75", "background": "#FFFFFF", "surface": "#F8F5FA", "divider": "#D8D2E0", "connector": "#8F86B4", "mark_outline": "#716684"}, "core_values_exact": true, "category_base_mapping": {"#3B82F6": "#8F86B4", "#10B981": "#B7ACCD", "#F59E0B": "#DBCCE2", "#8B5CF6": "#D6A3B1", "#CBD5E1": "#E8CCAB"}, "shading": {"space": "linear-sRGB", "front_and_top": "Use the exact assigned core color.", "light_cap_white_mix": 0.1, "outer_wall_light_multiplier": 0.5, "inner_wall_light_multiplier": 0.29, "radial_cut_light_multiplier": 0.39, "lighter_cut_light_multiplier": 0.6}}}

g.text: Sector angles encode revenue share. Heights are decorative.
Data Source: Finance Department Quarterly Report
